name: Kyouiku Shidou 2 ~Yamato Nadeshiko Zoushoku Keikaku~
original_name: 狂イク指導2 ～大和撫子増殖計画～
source:
There is a secret organization. The purpose of it is to train girls and make them modest and obedient. Girls who are regarded as violators are taken to a secret base and sexually assaulted in various ways. It never ends until they change... Target girls this time are a rookie nurse and an expensive flight attendant.

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
存在一个秘密组织，其目的是训练女性，使她们变得端庄服从。被认定违反规范的女性会被带到秘密基地，遭受各种性侵犯；在她们改变以前，这一切永远不会结束…本次的目标是一名新人护士和一名高薪空乘人员。

[摘自ErogeShop]
